name: Newar
notes: Newar (Nepal Bhasa, नेपाल भाषा) of the Kathmandu Valley, ~850,000-1 million speakers, official language of the Kathmandu Metropolitan City and a recognised national language of Nepal; written today in Devanagari (historically also in the Ranjana and other Nepalese scripts). DEEP FIX (2026-08): the earlier `graphemes_base: hi` reading was Hindi's reading applied uncritically; error analysis against `new_deva_narrow.tsv` (WikiPron narrow gold, 416 rows) found FOUR real, systematic mismatches with Genetti's (2007) and Hale & Shrestha's (2006) description of Newar phonology, now fixed as own overrides on top of `graphemes_base: hi`: (1) `inherent_vowel` was never declared on this spec (an OWN_ONLY field -- `graphemes_base` does not inherit it), so NO schwa was being inserted after bare consonants at all (कथु -> *ktʰu instead of gold 'k ə tʰ u'); declaring `inherent_vowel: 'ə'` fixes this, by far the single largest source of error. (2) Newar does not delete the written inherent vowel word-finally or medially in clusters the way Hindi's schwa-deletion/schwa-syncope rules do (no such process is described for Newar in Genetti 2007 or Hale & Shrestha 2006, unlike the well-documented Hindi/Nepali rule -- Narasimhan, Sproat & Kiraz 2004): all inherited `HI_SCHWA_FINAL_*`/`HI_SCHWA_MEDIAL_*`/`HI_SCHWA_KEEP_*` allophone rules are neutralised here by identity-mapping overrides of the same ids, e.g. अउल -> gold 'ə u l ə' (not Hindi-style *'əʊl'). (3) ः (visarga) is not read as /h/ in Newar practical orthography; it marks a lengthened final vowel (Hale & Shrestha 2006's romanization notes) -- overridden from Hindi's `h` to `əː`, e.g. अंगः -> gold 'ə̃ː ɡ əː', कःनि -> gold 'k əː n i'. (4) the sibilant/retroflex-nasal letters श, ष, ण are read the same as स, न in Newar (a 3-way Indo-Aryan sibilant contrast and retroflex nasal that Newar's own phonemic inventory does not have -- PHOIBLE lists only one sibilant, `s̪|s`, and no `ɳ` for newa1246), overridden to `s`/`s`/`n` respectively (भाषा -> gold 'bʱ a s a', अर्थपूर्ण -> gold '... ɾ n ə'). The dental stop series त/थ/द is also read WITHOUT the dental diacritic in this gold's convention (कथु -> 'tʰ' not 't̪ʰ'), matching the plain-alternative already declared in `phonemes` (`t̪|t`, `d̪|d`); ध keeps Hindi's `dʱ` (breathy but NOT dental-marked in the gold either -- धर्म -> 'dʱ ə ɾ m ə'). The murmured/breathy SONORANT series (m̤, n̤, l̤, r̤ per Genetti 2007's phonation contrast), written with ह-conjuncts (न्ह, म्ह, ल्ह, र्ह) in Devanagari, is now mapped directly to those phonemes, spelled with the gold's own `ʱ` notation (न्ह -> gold 'nʱ', म्हुतु -> gold 'mʱ u t u'); previously these conjuncts fell through to Hindi's literal न+ह = 'nɦ' reading. RESULT: PER on `new_deva_narrow.tsv` dropped from 0.5525 to 0.4371 (see `benchmarks/results.json`), a ~21% relative reduction, all four fixes cited above. RESIDUAL (not fixed, left as documented narrow-transcription convention, per the pre-existing KNOWN GAP): (a) vowel QUALITY/LENGTH -- the gold's actual pronunciation is not fully predictable from which vowel matra is written (आलु -> gold 'a l u', not the Hindi-style laxed/lengthened *'aːlʊ'; कि -> gold 'k i' not *'kɪ'); Newar's vowel length is phonemic and independent of the (historically Sanskrit/Hindi-derived) short/long matra distinction, so no purely grapheme-level rule can close this without a lexical length dictionary outside this task's scope. (b) the narrow affricate symbol: ज is generalised narrowly to d͡ʑ in the gold's palatal-affricate convention vs the inherited dʒ (postalveolar) -- a transcription-convention choice, not a phonemic difference Genetti (2007) or PHOIBLE describe. (c) word-final ⟨य्⟩ (y + virama) surfaces in the gold as a monophthongised front vowel (अय् -> gold 'ɛː', आय् -> gold 'æː') rather than the grapheme-compositional vowel+glide (*'əj'/*'aːj') -- a lexicalised sandhi/diphthong-reduction pattern that would need per-word or positional-glide rules beyond this pass. STRESS: no lexical stress contrast is described for Newar in Genetti (2007) (word-level prominence is not phonemically distinctive); left unencoded, a documented exemption. TIER: `research` -- sourced (Genetti 2007; Hale & Shrestha 2006; PHOIBLE), stress exemption documented, and `new_deva_narrow.tsv` (416 rows, WikiPron/Wiktionary scrape, `crowd-scraped` provenance, registered below) is scored in `scripts/benchmark.py` with a PER recorded in `benchmarks/results.json`.
